column1: # How each weapon looks and feels (presentation only - the sim never reads this; weapons.tsv is the rules).
# Every weapon in weapons.tsv needs a row here (rules.gd checks). Values moved out of code 15 Oct 2026
# (Fable review #20: they were hard-coded in juice.gd, actors.gd, device_haptics.gd, primitive_catalog.gd).
# kick_ms / kick_amp: phone vibration per shot (0 ms = none; fast guns would buzz constantly).
# muzzle_sparks / muzzle_smoke: particles per shot. bullet_stretch: length / width of the bullet.
# bullet_arc: lob height in metres at mid-range (grenade). bullet_grow: extra size at max range (flame cone).
# smoke_trail: 1 = leaves a smoke trail (rocket). model_length / model_radius: barrel of the stand-in model.
